source.publisher: MHCLG Energy Performance of Buildings Register / public building records
source.title: City Core office building roster, Cheapside/Gresham/Wood, Old Bailey/Ludgate/Fleet Place and Cannon Street corridors (per-row provenance in notes)

_method: Identity and physical constants for the City Core peer roster and the three Nan Fung holdings that sit on it, harvested 2026-08-29. Floor areas and completion years come from the public record named in each row's note; where sources conflict, the figure used and the alternatives are both stated. EPC ratings are current whole-building certificates on the non-domestic register, read from certificate pages (find-energy-certificate.service.gov.uk/energy-certificate/<number>); a building with only per-unit, per-floor or expired certificates carries no rating, and the note says what the register does hold. year_built is the original completion year of the current building; comprehensive refurbishments are dated in the note, not in year_built -- The Bailey is the one judgement call (1999, the vintage of the extension holding ~90% of its area, over its 1912 listed front block). sqft bases vary by source (NIA, GIA, office-only, office-and-retail) and each note names its basis where the source did. Unlike the Canary Wharf file, three buildings here ARE holdings (138 Cheapside, 108 Cannon Street, The Bailey): they are real buildings on a real street, and the peer matcher excludes a building from its own peer set by name.

buildings.name: 138 Cheapside
buildings.note: HOLDING (Cheapside House). Area: nanfung.com, 80,300 sq ft office building with retail units (RBW Estates says ~82,500). Built 1956-58, architect Theodore Birks for Bernard Sunley & Sons (Morrow + Lorraine project Q&A; Manchester Victorian Architects database). Basement, ground and 8 upper floors. No whole-building EPC: the register holds per-floor certificates for the 1st-8th floors and per-unit retail certificates only. Repositioned 2019 (Faithdean, Cat A across four floors).

buildings.name: 150 Cheapside
buildings.note: Area (office NIA): Savills brochure via search index. Year, floors, architect (Michael Aukett for St Martins Property): niaziroden.com; Buildington. EPC B(49), whole building 24,103 m2, to 2034-07-03, cert 5599-8571-5998-7468-0884.

buildings.name: 107 Cheapside
buildings.note: Area: 107cheapside.london marketing site (Buildington says 156,000). Built 1957, comprehensively redeveloped 2007-08 by John Robertson Architects for Carlyle (Focchi facade project page); Morrow + Lorraine reception retrofit for Invesco completed 2023-24. EPC B(49), whole building 21,977 m2, to 2034-03-03, cert 8766-4022-4802-2436-5401.

buildings.name: 100 Cheapside
buildings.note: Area (Grade A office; +13,400 sq ft retail): Premier Construction News. Completed October 2014, EPR Architects, contractor Skanska, for Quadrant Estates/CarVal/Orion/City Corporation JV; BREEAM Excellent, LEED Platinum. EPC B(45), whole building 10,140 m2, to 2033-06-27, cert 2041-0837-9365-9375-2063.

buildings.name: 80 Cheapside
buildings.note: Area, year: LoopNet listing via search index (NovaLoca says ~80,000 over seven office floors). Repositioned 2019 by Woods Bagot for Ideal Century Investment. No current whole-building EPC: the D(85) certificate expired 2024-04-08; current certificates are per-floor.

buildings.name: 2 Gresham Street
buildings.note: Area: Buildington (NLA says 177,000). Original completion year unsourced -- Investec HQ from 2000, comprehensively repositioned by BuckleyGrayYeoman for St Martins, completed 2021 (NLA says May 2022) -- so it carries no year and drops out of age-banded peer sets. EPC B(46), whole building 24,700 m2, to 2031-07-04, cert 1330-4632-2528-6253-1894 (registered under EC2V 7QP).

buildings.name: 20 Gresham Street
buildings.note: Area: CO-RE/Buildington. KPF for Hermes, completed 2008 (some sources say 2009); John Robertson Architects deep retrofit completing 2026, which is why the VOA aggregate covers only part of the building. EPC B(42), 29,882 m2, to 2036-07-28, cert 2829-7322-3659-5650-3714.

buildings.name: 25 Gresham Street
buildings.note: Area, year: Buildington (11,132 m2). Grimshaw island-site HQ for IVG Asticus; Lloyds Banking Group registered head office; sold to Hengli Investments 2017. EPC B(43), whole building 13,040 m2, to 2033-10-19, cert 6390-0121-0531-4254-2605.

buildings.name: 30 Gresham Street
buildings.note: Area: Wikipedia. Sidell Gibson for Land Securities, completed 2002-03, contractor Sir Robert McAlpine. EPC C(60), building-level 48,981 m2, to 2028-07-25, cert 0460-0538-5469-7423-3006.

buildings.name: 45 Gresham Street
buildings.note: 'Gresham St Paul's', the 1998 SOM-designed Garrard House (ex-Schroders HQ), deep retrofit by WilkinsonEyre for Stanhope/AFIAA completed February 2021; c.170,000 sq ft offices (marketing says 165,000). No CEPC on the register at EC4M 7BG -- air-conditioning certificates only -- though marketing claims EPC B; the register-first rule leaves the rating empty.

buildings.name: 95 Gresham Street
buildings.note: Princes House and Bartlett House unified behind a retained Portland stone facade by Rolfe Judd, completed 2010 (agent listings; 93,606 sq ft NIA per LoopNet). Original construction era of the retained buildings unsourced, so no year_built. EPC C(64), whole building 10,346 m2, to 2032-08-15, cert 2918-8620-3485-6813-8140.

buildings.name: 1 Wood Street
buildings.note: Area, year: LoopNet via search index, corroborated by KanAm Grund (17,000 m2). Fletcher Priest for Land Securities; Eversheds Sutherland London HQ. EPC B(41), whole building 19,095 m2, to 2033-10-31, cert 4152-8069-9323-1478-2170.

buildings.name: 88 Wood Street
buildings.note: Richard Rogers Partnership for Daiwa, slabs of 8, 14 and 18 storeys; area is Wikipedia's 33,000 m2 gross conversion -- no published NIA found. Completion 1999 per RSHP project dates (one Wikipedia article says 1998). EPC D(89), whole building 34,325 m2, to 2031-12-08, cert 3919-3473-7260-4246-2370.

buildings.name: 100 Wood Street
buildings.note: Area, year: Cushman & Wakefield listing (completed April 2000, Helical Bar). Foster + Partners. EPC C(72), building-level 18,968 m2, to 2034-06-25, cert 2014-9309-2548-6927-6131.

buildings.name: The Bailey
buildings.note: HOLDING, 16 Old Bailey. Area, floors: Endurance Land / Orms (uplifted from 92,000 sq ft). year_built 1999 is the vintage of the extension holding ~90% of the area, over the Grade II listed 1912 front block; Orms deep retrofit retained 92% of the structure, practical completion April 2021. EPC A(25), whole building 13,705 m2, to 2031-02-16, cert 4695-1453-7318-1831-9988.

buildings.name: 20 Old Bailey
buildings.note: Area (NIA): Turner & Townsend alinea / Vision (marketing says 240,000). A 1980s block -- exact original year unpublished, so no year_built -- cut-and-carve redeveloped by BuckleyGrayYeoman for Blackstone, completed 2017; sold to Mirae for £341m in 2018. EPC B(27), whole building 29,782 m2, to 2027-11-28, cert 0190-0433-4819-0129-6096.

buildings.name: Mizuho House, 30 Old Bailey
buildings.note: Two New Ludgate, Sauerbruch Hutton for Land Securities, completed 2015. Area is Landsec's office-and-retail total (office element 198,630 per Buildington). Offices let entirely to Mizuho Bank on a 20-year lease; sold with One New Ludgate to Sun Venture for £552m combined, December 2020. EPC B(41), whole building 24,831 m2, to 2034-12-18, cert 1718-7623-4814-2174-3005.

buildings.name: 10 Old Bailey
buildings.note: Area: owner Longmead Capital (basis unstated). Built 2009 adjoining the Central Criminal Court; Spratley & Partners refurbishment completed 2021, further all-electric refurbishment marketed since. EPC B(49), whole building 8,889 m2, to 2033-02-06, cert 0949-5006-4525-8917-1580; marketing claims A, which matches newer floor-level certificates only.

buildings.name: 60 Ludgate Hill
buildings.note: One New Ludgate, Fletcher Priest for Land Securities, completed 2015. Area is Landsec's office-and-retail total (office element 157,917 per Buildington). Ropes & Gray, Commonwealth Bank of Australia. No CEPC on the register at EC4M 7AW -- air-conditioning certificates only.

buildings.name: Procession House, 55 Ludgate Hill
buildings.note: Island site above City Thameslink, completed late 1999 (Savills); area is the 2017 office-and-retail launch figure (post-refurbishment sources say 8,700 m2 offices). Repositioned by John Robertson Architects, completed May 2020; sold to Union Investment June 2020. Only whole-building EPC (E, 2008) expired 2019-01-08, pre-refurbishment; nothing current on the register. The VOA aggregate covers 3 hereditaments, part of the building.

buildings.name: Cannon Place, 78 Cannon Street
buildings.note: Air-rights building above Cannon Street station, Foggo Associates for Hines with Network Rail; area is the Class A office figure (418,198 sq ft total per Buildington). No current EPC: an expired 2020 DEC and a current air-conditioning certificate are all the register holds.

buildings.name: 25 Cannon Street
buildings.note: Area: Pembroke (completion press said 120,414). Portland-stone building opposite St Paul's, developed by Pembroke in 2000, revitalised 2022 by Buckley Gray Yeoman with a 5,400 sq ft roof terrace. EPC B(42), offices certificate covering 12,798 m2, to 2032-04-28, cert 8016-9582-7553-2513-2059.

buildings.name: 45 Cannon Street
buildings.note: New-build by Fletcher Priest for London Watling Court B.V. with Morgan Capital, completed 2017; area is the office element of 90,000 sq ft total (Buildington). No whole-building EPC: tenant and retail-unit certificates only.

buildings.name: Watling House, 33 Cannon Street
buildings.note: Developed 1999 by British Land; area is the Grade A office element (95,332 sq ft total with retail/pub, NovaLoca). Reception and top floor refurbished c.2021. No whole-building EPC: unit-level certificates only.

buildings.name: 110 Cannon Street
buildings.note: Area: Buildington (6,970 m2 office). Original construction year unsourced -- comprehensively refurbished spring 2012 by MoreySmith for USS after its 2011 purchase from Landsec -- so no year_built. EPC C(70), whole building 10,555 m2, to 2034-04-23, cert 2486-3144-7546-8098-7982.

buildings.name: Yarnwicke, 119-121 Cannon Street
buildings.note: Formerly Sherborne House, an early-1980s building (a 1984 IStructE construction paper describes it; no explicit completion year published, so no year_built); comprehensively refurbished and extended (two-storey CLT addition) by Barr Gazetas for Riverside Capital, completed 2022. Area: sale particulars via BE News. No whole-building EPC: the A(25) certificate covers the 3rd-6th floors only (cert 9515-8543-5432-9003-1120); marketing describes the building as EPC A.

buildings.name: 108 Cannon Street
buildings.note: HOLDING. Area: nanfung.com (the VOA office aggregate agrees at 38,330 sq ft). A 1980s building -- exact year unpublished, so no year_built -- comprehensively refurbished and extended by Endurance Land, completed 2023 (Barr Gazetas): rebuilt 6th floor, new 7th, four-storey rear extension. EPC B(35), whole building 5,089 m2, to 2036-06-02, cert 6516-5434-8800-9221-7767.

buildings.name: 1 Fleet Place
buildings.note: SOM-designed, Bovis-built 1992 block of the Ludgate air-rights scheme over City Thameslink; area: BD press figure, not marketed NIA. Dentons' London HQ, vacating 2026; KPF's 155,000 sq ft 'Tessera' refurbishment consented November 2025, due 2029 -- which also explains the building's low £/m² in the 2024-basis rating list. EPC D(88), whole building 14,919 m2, to 2029-11-07, cert 0910-2954-0331-1810-0020 (registered under EC4M 7RA).

buildings.name: Fleet Place House, 2 Fleet Place
buildings.note: SOM for Heron Property Corporation, built 2000 (NovaLoca); externally-expressed steel columns, no internal columns. Area: CBRE (Buildington says 91,955 over basement, ground and 8 upper). Sold by Grosvenor to Beijing Capital Development 2017 for £96.5m. EPC C(60), whole building 11,069 m2, to 2032-09-11, cert 8186-0620-4435-6146-3983.

buildings.name: 5 Fleet Place
buildings.note: SOM for British Land, completed 2007 (Buildington; a contractor case study says 2008); area: CBRE. Charles Russell Speechlys HQ. EPC C(65), whole building 14,452 m2, to 2031-10-20, cert 9537-1153-5025-4201-8372.

buildings.name: 10 Fleet Place
buildings.note: SOM for the British Rail Property Board, completed 1993 per SOM's own project page (agent listings say c.1992); renovated 2008 to ~177,757 sq ft offices plus retail (Addington/LoopNet via search index); rolling Cat A refurbishment delivering into Q1 2026. EPC B(47), whole building 20,489 m2, to 2034-08-15, cert 4038-6845-7126-7975-7410.

buildings.name: Sancroft, 10-15 Newgate Street
buildings.note: Formerly Christchurch Court, Goldman Sachs' former City office, originally 2003 (owner Mitsui Fudosan; Mingtiandi says 2000-vintage) -- not the BT Centre, which is 81 Newgate Street. Shimao's £54m BuckleyGrayYeoman refurbishment and rooftop extension completed April 2022, rebranded Sancroft; sold to Greycoat/Mitsui Fudosan for £315m, April 2023. Area: owner's 309,000 sq ft office-and-retail figure. ICE, Goodwin Procter, Convene. EPC A(25) covering the office building excluding gym and retail, 32,556 m2, to 2034-05-17, cert 8517-9803-9722-9013-8966.
